# sonarqube_alm_github (Resource)

A GitHub DevOps platform setting. Every attribute changes in place. Destroying a setting that projects are still bound to is refused, because SonarQube would remove their bindings with it. Import ID: the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The *_wo arguments keep credentials out of state (Terraform 1.11+).
# Change credentials_wo_version to apply new values.
resource "sonarqube_alm_github" "main" {
  key                    = "github"
  url                    = "https://api.github.com/"
  app_id                 = "123456"
  client_id              = "Iv1.0123456789abcdef"
  client_secret_wo       = var.github_client_secret
  private_key_wo         = var.github_private_key
  webhook_secret_wo      = var.github_webhook_secret
  credentials_wo_version = "1"
}

variable "github_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "github_webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "github_private_key" {
  description = "PEM private key of the GitHub App."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) GitHub App ID.
- `client_id` (String) GitHub App client ID.
- `key` (String) Unique key of the setting. Changing it renames the setting in place, keeping its project bindings.
- `url` (String) GitHub API URL, e.g. `https://api.github.com/`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) GitHub App client secret. Stored in state; prefer `client_secret_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `client_secret`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.
- `credentials_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current values of the `_wo` arguments.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) GitHub App private key (PEM). Stored in state; prefer `private_key_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `private_key`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) GitHub App webhook secret. Stored in state; prefer `webhook_secret_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `webhook_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `webhook_secret`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The setting key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_alm_github.example 'github'
```
